fatal_reason: Both experimental test sections were decommissioned in summer 2005, before the Sentinel-1 observation era.
same_surface_support: Both sections received the same 150-mm topsoil layer and the same grass seed mixture; oleander seedlings were additionally planted on the thicker section.

sources.title: Using Pilot Test Data to Refine an Alternative Cover Design in Northern California
sources.key_support: Reports construction in 1999, exact layer thicknesses, monitoring through 2005, and decommissioning of both sections in summer 2005.
